About us

I.J. Projects is a family-founded building and project management company with over 50 years of industry experience, delivering high-quality building, civil construction and project management services across South Australia. The company specialises in managing commercial, government and infrastructure projects from planning through to successful completion and has established a strong reputation for quality, safety and client satisfaction


About the role

As our business continues to expand, we are seeking an experienced Sales and Marketing Manager to lead the company's sales, business development and marketing functions. This is a newly established full-time permanent management position reporting directly to senior management and will play a key role in driving business growth, strengthening the company's market presence, and developing long-term relationships with government, commercial and institutional clients


Key responsibilities:

- Develop and implement the company's sales and marketing strategies to achieve sustainable business growth and increase market share.
- Identify new business opportunities, analyse market trends and competitor activities, and develop strategic growth initiatives.
- Lead the company's business development activities by establishing and maintaining relationships with government agencies, developers, consultants, contractors and key industry stakeholders.
- Oversee the preparation of marketing strategies, promotional campaigns and brand positioning to enhance the company's profile within the construction and project management sectors.
- Direct the development and implementation of client relationship management strategies to strengthen customer retention and generate repeat business.
- Work closely with senior management to identify and pursue major project opportunities, including government and private sector procurement and tender opportunities.
- Prepare sales forecasts, marketing budgets, business performance reports and strategic recommendations for senior management.
- Lead, mentor and manage sales and marketing personnel to achieve business objectives and maintain high performance standards.
- Represent the company at industry events, networking functions and stakeholder meetings to promote the company's services and establish strategic partnerships.


Selection criteria:

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Marketing, Management, Commerce or a related discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in a senior sales and marketing management role with responsibility for developing and implementing strategic business growth initiatives.
- Proven ability to develop commercial opportunities and build strong relationships with government agencies, commercial clients, developers and key industry stakeholders.
- Strong strategic planning, leadership, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience preparing sales forecasts, marketing plans and business performance reports.
- Previous experience within the building, construction, engineering or project management industry will be highly regarded; applicants with transferable senior sales and marketing management experience from other industries are also encouraged to apply.

Salary: $130,000 per annum (base), plus superannuation
Location: Adelaide, South Australia
How to apply: Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Your new company     An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to join a well-established technology services organisation with a growing presence in Tasmania.  Based in Hobart, this permanent role will see you supporting and improving enterprise Linux and cloud environments that underpin critical services across the state. Working closely with both local and national engineering teams, you'll play a key role in maintaining platform stability, security and operational excellence in mission-critical environments where availability and reliability are paramount.    Your new role     As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for administering and supporting Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments, ensuring systems remain secure, available and performing at their best. You will manage patching and upgrades, monitor infrastructure health, respond to incidents, and contribute to ongoing platform improvement initiatives.  Working across Azure and AWS environments, you'll help strengthen infrastructure resilience, support security and compliance requirements, and participate in a 24/7 on-call roster. You'll take ownership of critical incidents from identification through to resolution, applying strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills while working within established change management and governance frameworks. You'll also be responsible for conducting root cause analysis and maintaining operational documentation and standards.    What you'll need to succeed   
 
 Mandatory RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer) certification 
 Strong experience administering enterprise Linux/RHEL environments 
 Infrastructure engineering experience within enterprise or managed services environments 
 Experience supporting Azure and/or AWS platforms 
 Strong troubleshooting, incident management and problem-solving skills 
 Experience with patching, upgrades, system hardening and vulnerability remediation 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively 
 The ability to pass a mandatory police check 
 
 Highly regarded: 
 
 Experience within utilities, critical infrastructure, OT environments or managed services 
 
  What you'll get in return     You'll join a growing Hobart engineering team backed by experienced national engineering resources across Australia. In return, you'll gain exposure to enterprise scale Linux and cloud environments, enjoy flexible hybrid working arrangements, receive an on-call allowance, and have the opportunity to further develop your career within a collaborative and technically focused organisation that values accountability, continuous improvement and technical excellence.   What you need to do now

Summary: 
Join a world-leading School of Computer Science and Engineering and help shape the next generation of software engineers through innovative, high-quality teaching across contemporary Software Engineering disciplines.

Job Details
•	Salary, 
o	Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $127,947 to $150,830 per annum + 17% superannuation
o	Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $155,403 to $178,290 per annum + 17% superannuation
•	Full-time
•	2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
•	Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
Join the School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in an Education Focused role. In this role, you will contribute to excellence in teaching and learning across Software Engineering, while helping to shape the next generation of software engineering professionals and computing graduates.

You will contribute to teaching across Software Engineering disciplines at undergraduate and postgraduate levels, delivering engaging learning experiences that prepare students for industry and research careers. You will play a key role in curriculum development, innovative teaching practice, and enhancing the student learning experience across the School.

With established strengths in software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and systems, UNSW offers an exceptional environment for educators who are passionate about teaching excellence, curriculum innovation, and student success. You will contribute to a collaborative academic community committed to advancing education and preparing students for real-world impact.

This is an opportunity to join a global leader in Computer Science, with cutting-edge facilities, world-class faculty, and an innovative educational environment. With strong industry partnerships and a commitment to educational excellence, UNSW provides excellent opportunities for career development, collaboration, and impact.

About You
You are an engaging and passionate educator with expertise in Software Engineering and a commitment to delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences. You bring the ability to contribute to an inclusive and high-performing academic environment while supporting students across a range of Software Engineering disciplines.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will contribute to teaching, curriculum development, and student support across undergraduate and postgraduate courses, while continuing to develop your teaching practice and educational innovation capabilities.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate educational leadership through curriculum innovation, mentoring colleagues, leading teaching initiatives, and contributing to the advancement of teaching excellence across the School and broader UNSW Education Focused community.
You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to create meaningful learning experiences while building strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige, and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides a unique environment where academic expertise translates into real world outcomes. The university is home to cutting edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields. For academics, UNSW offers an outstanding platform to flourish — combining world class facilities, collaborative networks, and a culture of innovation that supports both career growth and meaningful contributions to the wider community.

The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and Bioinformatics, as well as a number of combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading and world building as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Actively stays up to date with discipline knowledge and professional development.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
•	Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience in work-integrated learning (desirable).
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Actively stays up to date with discipline knowledge and development.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience in implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others.
•	Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning. 
•	Evidence of professional development of teaching practice in self and others with the ability to advance and lead an inclusive culture of excellence in learning and teaching.
•	Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement.
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Additional details about the specific responsibilities for this position can be found in the position description. This is available via JOBS@UNSW. 

To Apply: 
If you are an educator passionate about delivering high-quality teaching and enhancing the student learning experience, whether as an emerging or experienced academic, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to innovative teaching practices, curriculum development, and educational excellence within the School. We encourage you to click the “Apply Now” button and submit your CV, cover letter, and responses addressing the Skills and Experience criteria.

If you're excited about this role and think you have what it takes, but your experience doesn't align 100%, we still want to hear from you and would encourage you to apply.

If you have had any interruption in your career, you are encouraged to include a ROPE statement as part of your application. For information on ROPE please check: 
https://www.arc.gov.au/about-arc/program-policies/research-opportunity-and-performance-evidence-rope-statement

Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Keshab Pty Ltd, the founding entity of the KHI Partners network, is part of a growing professional services group operating across Australia and the United Kingdom. KHI Partners comprises more than 30 Partners, 13+ Australian offices and provides Accounting & Tax, Bookkeeping, Financial Planning, Mortgage Broking, Legal, Buyers Agency and Insurance Broking services through its specialist partner firms.

As the group's central recruitment and HR function supporting a workforce of over 150 employees, Keshab Pty Ltd is seeking a full-time Recruitment Consultant to manage end-to-end recruitment, onboarding and talent acquisition across the KHI Partners network. This role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to workforce planning and recruitment strategy within a dynamic and expanding professional services organisation.

Key responsibilities

-	Manage end-to-end recruitment across multiple entities within the KHI Partners Group including job design, advertising, sourcing, screening, interviewing and onboarding.
-	Develop and implement a group-wide recruitment and onboarding framework to ensure uniformity in processes and compliance with employment standards.
-	Partner with partners and practice heads to understand staffing requirements and deliver effective recruitment solutions.
-	Conduct reference and background checks, manage pre-employment screening and maintain recruitment documentation.
-	Track performance progress and gather staff feedback to support talent retention and workforce engagement initiatives.
-	Build and maintain candidate pipelines, develop relationships with external providers and industry associations.
-	Prepare recruitment metrics, dashboards and progress reports for leadership and partner meetings.
-	Support employer branding, social media and professional networking initiatives to attract top talent.
-	Contribute to workforce planning and succession strategies for the wider group.

Minimum / essential requirements

-	Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in HR, Business or related discipline OR significant demonstrable recruitment experience.
-	3 years’ end-to-end recruitment experience in a professional services environment, OR 5+ years’ broader recruitment experience.
-	Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to coordinate across multiple offices and senior management levels.
-	Good working knowledge of Australian employment law, recruitment best practice, payroll and performance management principles.
-	Excellent written & verbal communication, high integrity and proven ability to handle confidential matters.

Desirable

-	Experience recruiting for accounting, finance, legal or advisory roles.
-	Experience working in a multi-office professional services firm.
-	Data-driven approach to resourcing and forecasting.

To apply, please email your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted; all applications are treated as strictly confidential.
Keshab Pty Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.
